description: Compiled plans at PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION 14 (rules, with their source file, checks, and a verification item's verifies are written only when an item has them): every item stores its operation under 'operation' with an explicit 'type' (action, loop, workflow_transition, child_workflow); only the temporary root is normalized. Regenerate only with a deliberate format change and a schema bump.

cases.name: terminal_handoff
cases.yaml:
handlers:
  - name: finalize
    prompt: true
workflows:
  - name: decide
    handoff: true
    hooks:
      before_complete_workflow:
        - name: finalize
    steps:
      - name: choose
        provide:
          - name: workflow
        hooks:
          after_complete:
            - workflow: "{{workflow}}"

cases.name: sequence_and_command_hooks
cases.yaml:
handlers:
  - name: prepare
    command:
      shell: printf start > started.txt
  - name: record
    provide:
      - name: commit_message
        description: Commit summary.
    command:
      shell: printf "%s" "$COMMIT_MESSAGE" > committed.txt
      env:
        COMMIT_MESSAGE: "{{commit_message}}"

hooks:
  before_start_workflow:
    - name: prepare
  before_complete:
    - steps: [fix]
      name: record

workflows:
  - name: task
    steps:
      - name: group
        steps:
          - name: plan
            prompt: true
            description: Plan it.
          - name: fix
            prompt: true
            description: Fix it.
  - name: choose
    handoff: true
    steps:
      - name: select
        prompt: true
        provide:
          - name: workflow
            description: Target workflow.
        hooks:
          after_complete:
            - workflow: "{{workflow}}"
